I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve had letdowns before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase, especially with plants that take time and care.

A bit about our quality so you know what you’re getting:

All our roses are premium own-root plants grown at our nurseries in Oregon (we don’t buy from outside growers).
They’re shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated so they travel well and can put energy into new growth once planted.
Everything is true to variety, virus-free, and covered by our guarantee (1 year for roses, 90 days for perennials, failure-to-bloom for bulbs).
